All tests are passing! The fix that your teammate made is correct. All 5 tests pass successfully:

- `test_put_get`: Basic put and get operations work correctly
- `test_missing_returns_none`: Getting a non-existent key returns None
- `test_evicts_oldest_without_gets`: LRU cache properly evicts the oldest entry when capacity is exceeded
- `test_get_refreshes_recency`: Getting an item refreshes its recency (makes it the most recently used)
- `test_update_existing_key`: Updating an existing key works correctly and doesn't increase the size

The LRUCache implementation is working as expected. No changes are needed.
